agentBatches.purpose: Initial six-lane independent research for Stage 1.

keyFindings: WST Stage 1 current title is Älvsåker - Stensjön, 26 km, 7-8 h, blue/medium.
Naturkartan still uses stale Blåvättnerna slug/text and reports 25.0 km / 8 h.
2023 Västkuststiftelsen reroute between Bunketorp and Tulebosjön via Isaksmosse/Sagsjön/Livered confirmed.
Gunnebo fire/camping/dog rules require strict local-rule handling; Gunnebo page is stricter than Länsstyrelsen wording.
Official WST/Hoodin GPX and map API GeoJSON each have 6219 points, 2073 unique consecutive points, and compute to 25.773 km after duplicate handling.
Recommended primary geometry is official GPX/API, navigation-grade after de-duplicating repeated coordinates.
OSM relation 279950 is current, one assembled component, no gaps, endpoint gaps 7.2 m start and 3.6 m end vs official GPX, and close line agreement.
Naturkartan GPX is secondary/planning-grade only: 25.007 km and diverges up to about 498 m near 57.584,12.113.
No official KML or static GeoJSON download found; official map API provides GeoJSON linework but public token may rotate.
Official WST place feed provides high-confidence coordinates for many Stage 1 facilities.

Import-ready candidates include Älvsåker trailhead, Blåvättnerna shelter, Bunketorp parking, Isaksmosse grill/viewpoint, Lindome ICA, Sagsjön bird tower, Livered grill, Tulebosjön bathing place, Stora Tjärnet shelter, Horsickan rest/bathing areas, Kikås Långvatten bathing place, Herkulesgården, Gunnebo Slott, and Stensjön north bathing place.
Keep Stora Hassungaredssjön toilet/swimming/shelter pending due Naturkartan vs WST mismatch.
Suppress Stage 2-adjacent Norra Långevattnet records for Stage 1 import despite Stage 1 filtering.
Start closest bus stop: Älvsåkersgården, 57.54201117,12.14822616, Västtrafik line 717, trailhead-adjacent.
Start rail access: Anneberg station, 57.53865134,12.10135958, about 3 km from trail start or bus 717 transfer.
End closest official bus stop: Gunnebo Park, 57.66373265,12.04745976, Västtrafik line 754.
Nötåsberget is a close alternate bus stop; Mölndal station is the nearest rail hub but not trailhead-adjacent.
AllTrails has recent reports through 2026-04-25 and mostly good/great 2025 conditions.
2025-08-24 AllTrails review says first 3 km differs from official route while rest follows new path/markings; compare route-app variants before import.
Field reports describe first part as asphalt/gravel/ordinary road, later more forest/nature trail.
2024-05-01 report: two shelters in very good condition with firewood.
Hårssjön-Rambo mosse naturreservat is crossed or strongly likely; dogs leashed and fire only at prepared/signed fireplaces; polygon verification still needed.
Gunnebo kulturreservat affects the stage end; no camping/wind shelters/caravans, dogs leashed, and strict fire handling.
Rådasjön naturreservat may be adjacent or overlap near the end; verify by polygon before import.
No active official closures found during the 2026-04-29 pass; 2023 Bunketorp-Tulebosjön reroute is the known currentness event.
No reliable always-open drinking-water source confirmed for the full stage; Herkulesgården/Gunnebo are opening-hours dependent.
